title: CUSATNLP@HASOC-Dravidian-CodeMix-FIRE2020: Identifying Offensive Language from Manglish Tweets
reasoning: The paper describes the development and evaluation of a classification system for detecting offensive language in code-mixed Manglish text. It focuses on technical performance metrics (Precision, Recall, F1-score) and neural network architectures (LSTM, Doc2Vec) without any component evaluating religion, morals, or ethics.
